authority.quote: 然後下面這一大坨可以想辦法優化掉嗎？我不是說 Status 可以收合嗎？然後下方功能列表也做出來的話不是可以生很多事嗎？你多學學 Legacy吧。

requiredOutcomes: Keep the normal bottom status presentation compact and single-line. Allow truncation in the summary, with an explicit accessible click/keyboard disclosure for complete wrapping/scrolling messages and applicable Locate node action. No loss of diagnostics.

Make the large Shader Output/diagnostic area collapsible and open on demand; avoid permanent empty vertical space. Keep generated GLSL and errors reachable and retain current Graph/session state when opening/closing.

Provide a compact bottom function bar grouping existing operation hints/help, experimental controls and diagnostic/detail access into appropriate anchored disclosures. Do not spread long instructions and every debug control over the full width.
Keep details pointer-reachable, correctly targeted and safely keyboard-readable after these layout changes. No second large persistent debug panel or removal of useful object information.

Use independently implemented reusable control/popup primitives based on minimal Legacy behavior/state observations. Preserve white-alpha text, type colors, unchanged geometry and focus/gesture/lifetime fences.

Verify direct/wrapped1920/1440/620 and constrained preview sizes; Canvas gains the recovered space, status and function controls remain visible/reachable without overlap. Wider workspace tab/docking work remains deferred.
engineeringDefaults: Compact default presentation with explicit on-demand disclosure is the Coordinator normalization of the Human request; do not invent persistent history, named presets or a new global layout system. Reuse existing view/UI state seams, not Graph History.
writer: Same original Implementer already dispatched; send as ongoing steering, not a second task/writer.
separateControls: No acceptance, remote publication, merge or next Slice.
